findings.title: Deleting cache does not invalidate connectedCalendars query
findings.body: The deleteCacheMutation only shows a toast and calls the optional onSuccess callback. Unlike disconnectMutation, it never calls utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate(). The connectedCalendars query is what supplied cacheUpdatedAt, so after a successful delete the UI can continue showing the old cache status and timestamp until some unrelated refetch occurs.

findings.title: dev:cron uses npx tsx but tsx is not a declared dependency
findings.body: The script was changed to 'npx tsx cron-tester.ts', but tsx is not listed in dependencies or devDependencies for this package. npx may download tsx on demand or fail in offline/CI/Yarn PnP environments, making 'yarn dev:cron' non-deterministic. Either add tsx as a devDependency or use a command backed by an already-installed dependency.

findings.title: BSD-only sed -i '' syntax breaks on Linux
findings.body: The script uses 'sed -i '' -E ...', which is valid on BSD/macOS sed but not on GNU sed. On Linux, GNU sed does not consume the separate empty string as the backup suffix, so the empty argument is treated as a file operand and the command errors or behaves unexpectedly. Use portable syntax such as 'sed -i -E' or add an OS check.

findings.title: Cache timestamp is always formatted in en-US
findings.body: The timestamp display hardcodes Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', ...). Users with other locales will see a US-style date/time format even though the rest of the UI is localized. The user's locale or Cal.com time format should be used instead.

findings.title: No tests cover deleteCache authorization or cache status enrichment
findings.body: The PR adds a security-sensitive mutation that checks credential ownership before deleting CalendarCache rows and enriches connectedCalendars with cacheUpdatedAt. The diff includes no automated tests for the unauthorized case (one user targeting another user's credential), successful deletion, or the cacheUpdatedAt mapping. This leaves the ownership boundary and the new UI-visible behavior unverified.
